title: Rules.
bodyText: The invasive species council may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91, to effectuate this [chapter].
bodyHtml: [§194-7  Rules.]  The invasive species council may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91, to effectuate this [chapter]. [L 2003, c 85, §8; am L 2004, c 10, §16; am L 2006, c 109, §2]
